scope: NEW seven group-read controls, not earlier current-person/policy, introduction, root-retention, migration-floor or installed functions. No claim of group mutation UI parity, product execution, final-head acceptance, size-pressure coverage or live agents.

construction: Construct a bounded working DEC network through actual public creation/admission routes. The normal owned initial root signs only its own public creation/transition roles. A legitimate exact root transition then moves signing to a separately fixture-owned external key; later root/original signatures use their own signer fixture. No daemon private key is read, copied or exported.

Retain an independently usable owner and one other admitted person. Group members are their exact stable person_ IDs derived independently from admitted canonical public keys, never raw key strings or labels substituted for IDs.

Use actual public typed action writers or authenticated current-member catalog imports for independently signed ordinary groups. First public peer add pins only the independently verified actual own host ID/key and loopback listener; current H remains independently required. This transport configuration grants no operation/network authority. Retain named all-DB before/after hashes; any transport-contact/outbox bookkeeping is reported, not silently masked. Freeze the exact signed statement bytes, ds_, name, version and decoded members before reading the new endpoint.

Each scenario has a complete otherwise-valid root/person/host path and an independently complete current personal policy. Unrelated complete group streams remain present when testing aggregate failure.

Use separately constructed disposable actual public fixtures for expiry, withdrawal, fork and proof loss; never copy an actual store containing daemon/device/private key material. Never rewind an existing guard or rewrite an old signed object to obtain another scenario.

Every positive and negative read uses one held coherent decision-time precondition. Snapshot every fixture-created SQLite table and normative private record in a coherent read transaction; avoid noncoherent live file copies or immutable/nolock reads.

The parent has approved a bounded proof-loss fixture mutation, with no whole-store copy: preserve a separate positive fixture untouched, create a dedicated disposable actual fixture through ordinary public setup, stop that daemon and retain all DDL/rows/BLOB hashes. Remove only independently identified PUBLIC proof rows/containers from normative dec_objects, retaining exact removed public bytes and every private/admission/head/max/guard hash. Preserve a first failing fixture unchanged. Use a separate disposable actual fixture for each loss control. Do not guess columns, write an admission or modify a signed body.

For proof loss, enumerate all exact public aliases or containing public composites that supply the missing statement. If another retained public object still provides its complete bytes, the intended missing-body precondition is not established. Never assert proof_required while complete proof bytes remain available.
fixture.custody: Original fixture signer keys remain in their own signer homes; no daemon key copying. A foreground fixture establishes no installed or separate-machine custody claim.
fixture.signer_unavailable_read: For the read-only/native controls, restart the actual owner with no original-key daemon arguments or SSH agent. Preserve its selected provider row exactly, including an unavailable provider state. Verified cached public authority remains independently usable.

mandatory_read_oracles: GET /v2/networks/{id}/groups has no query/body. A200 response is exactly context_id plus groups; each row has exactly name, statement_id and statement_base64. Names are validated, sorted and unique.

Each successful row equals the exact independently signed ORIGINAL current group envelope and ds_, with canonical standard Base64. Decode the unsigned group-v1 body to compare actual stable members and full-u64 version; never manufacture a legacy signature or normalize signed bytes.

Before/after DB snapshots, clock guard, actual identity, context/origin, admissions, all maxima/head sets, provider selection/state, intents/signatures, outbox and authority events remain unchanged. A read performs no key generation, signing, consent, projection commit or remote repair.

Capture exact structured errors for the single isolated cause: proof_required has exact sorted unique IDs in required_ids and empty conflict_ids; state_conflict has exact sorted unique heads in conflict_ids and empty required_ids. Do not accept a union across diagnostic fields or invent precedence between different error classes.

Native success demonstrates the observable names/members/versions and lack of a signer requirement. Without separate instrumentation, do not claim to have traced its internal HTTP route or ruled out every attempted fallback solely from output.

cases.name: groups/complete_empty_current_view_is_exact_and_pure
assert: Before any group stream exists, a complete usable network returns200 exactly {context_id:ACTUAL_CONTEXT,groups:[]}.
All mandatory read-purity checks pass without a local signing key, an invented initial group or a fetch.

cases.name: groups/current_original_bytes_sorted_members_and_native_display_without_signer
assert: Create two current groups under independently valid current issuers in reverse name order. GET returns exactly the two name-sorted current ds_/ORIGINAL-byte rows, not historical bodies or an invented legacy view.
Native network groups, bound to its actual public help before execution, succeeds without an available signer and displays each exact current name, stable members and version.
Current persons/policy and actual provider state remain independent and unchanged; mandatory read-purity checks pass for API and native reads.

cases.name: groups/expired_higher_head_is_absent_without_lower_fallback_or_floor_reset
assert: Admit a longer-lived first group and a valid higher successor with a shorter finite deadline. Advance only the test DEC authority clock monotonically beyond the successor deadline while all required root/management authority and the lower historical body would still be live.

GET omits that group and retains every unrelated current group; no lower historical group becomes active. The expired higher admitted head/maximum and its exact proof bytes remain durable and unchanged.
Mandatory read-purity checks pass; advancing the test control file is fixture setup and the GET itself commits no guard.

cases.name: groups/withdrawn_administrator_group_is_inactive_while_unrelated_root_group_remains
assert: An independently admitted current administrator8 issues a current group. The actual current root then validly withdraws that exact administrator role without a group-preservation exception; group authority cannot be preserved by an admin-withdraw kept list.
GET omits the withdrawn-issuer group, keeps an independently current root-issued group and does not erase the inactive group's admitted high-water or retained original proofs.
The separate complete current personal policy remains readable and usable; the groups read performs no mutation.

cases.name: groups/any_remembered_group_fork_refuses_whole_aggregate_with_exact_heads
assert: Import two otherwise valid current sibling group successors with exact common predecessor and distinct signed bodies. Their independently computed ds_ heads establish one known group fork; another group remains complete and usable.
Whole GET returns the ordinary state_conflict with all exact conflicting head IDs sorted/unique. It never returns partial200, a hash-selected winner, an omitted forked entry or a lower body.
The unrelated complete personal policy remains independently readable. No read resolves the fork, advances a maximum, fetches proof or mutates any row.

cases.name: groups/missing_current_head_refuses_whole_aggregate_with_exact_proof_id
cases.execution_hold: Requires executable exact-public-row bindings in a dedicated disposable actual fixture and a separately offered supported artifact. No actual store/private key is copied; this declarative freeze performs no mutation.
assert: A previously admitted higher group head remains remembered with its exact maximum, while all copies of only its public body are genuinely absent in the stopped dedicated actual fixture. A lower historical group and an unrelated complete group remain available.
Whole GET returns proof_required with the exact independently derivable missing statement ID. It never falls back to the lower group, omits the incomplete stream or returns an unrelated partial200.

The separately complete personal policy remains independently readable. Preserve the faulted actual fixture's exact pre-read retained maxima/admissions and every remaining row; do not repair or refetch through this GET.

cases.name: groups/missing_required_ancestor_refuses_whole_aggregate_without_rewrite
cases.execution_hold: Requires executable exact-public-row bindings in a dedicated disposable actual fixture and a separately offered supported artifact. No actual store/private key is copied; this declarative freeze performs no mutation.
assert: A current group's signed head body is present, but an exact required predecessor/issuer ancestor is genuinely absent from all retained public objects. Freeze one isolated derivable missing ID and keep unrelated group/policy proofs complete.
Whole GET returns proof_required for that exact missing ID, without an incomplete entry, partial200, authority inferred from an admission marker or a synthesized ancestor.
Every remaining DB row, guard, provider, maximum/head, original proof and identity remains unchanged. The unrelated complete personal policy remains independently readable.

execution_gate: Freeze executable, public fixture/proof bindings and exact offered host/source hashes before any runtime. This freeze executes zero cases and offers no artifact. Preserve the first failure and continue only failed/unevaluated functions; necessary public prerequisite setup is uncounted and never invoked as an old positive test function.

executable_binding.public_native_help: network groups [ID]; global --state. Parent-provided Go42ab help is binding-only, not a runtime offer.
executable_binding.actual_fixtures: Seven independent disposable actual stores constructed through public routes; no prior positive function invoked. Stable person IDs are independently derived from actual admitted person public keys. Forks use distinct independently signed siblings under the legitimate external root.
executable_binding.proof_loss: For each dedicated stopped actual fixture, retain exact public removed rows/bytes and require the entire post-fault row set to equal the prior set minus only those independently hashed public rows. Every other public/private/admission/head/max/guard row and schema remains exact. Do not copy an actual store.
executable_binding.purity: API/native reads preserve every coherent DB-row hash and hash of non-DB state/HOME files; the latter detects unwanted key generation without exporting private bytes. Capture exact original public proof input before transmitting it.
executable_binding.native_scope: Visible current names, members (exact stable IDs or correctly resolved actual member labels) and versions; no unsupported assertion about internal HTTP tracing.
